title: Stocks Pressured by Weakness in Software and Tech Stocks
excerpt: The S&P 500 Index ($SPX ) (SPY ) today is up +0.17%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ($DOWI ) (DIA ) is down -0.03%, and the Nasdaq 100 Index ($IUXX ) (QQQ...
content_html:
The S&P 500 Index ($SPX) (SPY) today is up +0.17%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ($DOWI) (DIA) is down -0.03%, and the Nasdaq 100 Index ($IUXX) (QQQ) is down -0.30%.  September E-mini S&P futures (ESU26) are up +0.11%, and September E-mini Nasdaq futures (NQU26) are down -0.36%.

Stock indices are mixed today.  Weakness in software stocks is weighing on the broader market, led by a -15% plunge in Datadog after it reported Q2 adjusted gross margin below consensus.  Technology stocks are also under pressure, led by a -19% fall in AppLovin after it missed analysts' revenue estimates.  Memory chipmakers are retreating today after SanDisk forecast weaker-than-expected Q1 revenue.  Chipmakers are also weighed down by negative carryover from today's -4% decline in South Korea's Kospi Index, led by losses in SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics.

Some positive corporate earnings results are supporting stocks today. Motorola Solutions, IonQ, Paycom Software, Ormat, and Parker-Hannifin are all climbing today after forecasting stronger-than-expected revenue.   

Stocks also found support on today's better-than-expected US economic news, including weekly jobless claims, Q2 nonfarm productivity, and Q2 labor costs.

US weekly initial unemployment claims rose by +1,000 to 199,000, showing a stronger labor market than expectations of 205,000.

US Q2 nonfarm productivity rose +1.4%, stronger than expectations of +0.6%.  Q2 unit labor costs rose +1.3%, less than expectations of +2.1%.

A report today from the Financial Times was bearish for stocks and bonds after it said Fed Chair Warsh is willing to raise interest rates at the September FOMC meeting if inflation firms and market expectations shift further towards tightening in the coming months.

Sep WTI crude oil prices (CLU26) are up more than +1% today after Yemen's Houthi rebels said they targeted a Saudi oil tanker with a ballistic missile in the Gulf of Aden.  The markets are waiting for news of an Iran-Oman agreement to partially reopen the Strait of Hormuz.  A joint statement from the two countries is under review, and the route would remain active for two to four months, though the agreement does not mean a full reopening, according to Iranian officials.  Iran said that a normalization of the strait will depend on the US lifting its blockade on Iranian ports.

content_html_zh:
标准普尔 500 指数 ($SPX) (SPY) 今天上涨 +0.17%，道琼斯工业平均指数 ($DOWI) (DIA) 下跌 -0.03%，纳斯达克 100 指数 ($IUXX) (QQQ) 下跌 -0.30%。 9 月 E-mini 标准普尔期货 (ESU26) 上涨 +0.11%，9 月 E-mini 纳斯达克期货 (NQU26) 下跌 -0.36%。

今天股指涨跌互现。 软件股的疲软正在给更广泛的市场带来压力，其中 Datadog 报告第二季度调整后毛利率低于共识后暴跌 -15%。 科技股也面临压力，AppLovin 的营收未达到分析师预期，股价下跌 -19%。 在 SanDisk 预测第一季度收入低于预期后，内存芯片制造商今天纷纷撤退。 韩国 Kospi 指数今日下跌 -4%，导致芯片制造商受到负面结转的拖累，其中 SK 海力士和三星电子的跌幅最大。

一些积极的企业盈利结果支撑了今天的股市。 摩托罗拉解决方案、IonQ、Paycom Software、Ormat 和 Parker-Hannifin 在预测收入强于预期后，今天股价均在攀升。

今天好于预期的美国经济消息也为股市提供了支撑，其中包括每周申请失业救济人数、第二季度非农生产率和第二季度劳动力成本。

美国每周初请失业金人数增加 1,000 人至 199,000 人，显示劳动力市场强于预期的 205,000 人。

美国第二季度非农生产率增长+1.4%，强于预期的+0.6%。 第二季度单位劳动力成本上涨+1.3%，低于预期的+2.1%。

英国《金融时报》今天发布的一份报告对股市和债券构成利空，该报告表示，如果通胀稳定且市场预期在未来几个月进一步转向紧缩，美联储主席沃什愿意在 9 月的联邦公开市场委员会 (FOMC) 会议上加息。

9 月 WTI 原油价格 (CLU26) 今天上涨超过 1%，此前也门胡塞叛军称他们在亚丁湾用弹道导弹瞄准了一艘沙特油轮。 市场正在等待伊朗与阿曼达成协议，部分重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的消息。 伊朗官员表示，两国的联合声明正在审查中，该航线将保持活跃两到四个月，但该协议并不意味着全面重新开放。 伊朗表示，海峡正常化将取决于美国解除对伊朗港口的封锁。
